text: The plan builds a 20‑meter landing pad in zone Z1 and a 40‑meter blast berm in zone Z2 using two excavators, two haulers, one compactor, one printer, and one surveyor. Excavation and grading of the pad are split between EX2 and EX1, hauling of berm material uses HL2 in two trips, compaction is done by CP1, sintering by PR1, and surveying/inspection by SV1. The schedule completes in 89 hours, well under the 336‑hour horizon. The tightest constraint is the printer’s battery: sintering tasks consume 3957 Wh, leaving only 43 Wh for travel, which required reducing the S2 sintering area to 146 m². The solver verified that all precedence, single‑robot‑per‑zone, and energy limits are satisfied, with an optimal makespan of 89 hours.
